headline: 123 Left To Sweat On Haaland's Future
deck: City uncertainty puts 123's Haaland in the transfer gossip as Barcelona eye Estevao
body:
The gossip column names 123's most valuable asset, and it names him in the wrong context. Erling Haaland, the forward 123 holds, is drawn into the uncertainty at City in Monday's wire, the sort of paragraph an owner reads twice and then reads again.

Nothing is confirmed and nothing is imminent. The copy monitors interest, no more, and no timeline attaches to any of it. For 123 the material fact is unchanged: Haaland remains his player and remains in the line-up until something firmer than a gossip column says otherwise.
